company.name: Quillmoor Property Management

playbooks.label: Month-end trust reconciliation
playbooks.summary: Lines up each trust account's adjusted bank balance, receipts and disbursements record and owner ledger total, and lists the exceptions, each cleared or covered by the owner's reserve before distributions go out.

playbooks.label: Owner statements and distributions
playbooks.summary: Builds each owner's monthly statement from rent collected, expenses paid, the management fee and reserves, flags unusual expenses for a note, and checks the account is reconciled before the distribution goes out.

playbooks.label: Work order follow-up
playbooks.summary: Lists open work orders by vendor and how long they have been open, and those with no vendor update since last Monday, so the coordinator can follow up.

playbooks.label: Unpaid balance follow-up
playbooks.summary: Lists unpaid balances from the tenant ledgers by how long they have been open, and drafts a reminder for the property manager to review and send. Any notice is decided and served by a person.

playbooks.label: Lease renewals
playbooks.summary: Lists leases ending soon with where each renewal stands, so the property manager can follow up in time. Renewal terms are set by people.

playbooks.label: Vendor invoice approval
playbooks.summary: Matches each vendor invoice to its work order and routes invoices over the limit to the property manager before accounting pays them.

playbooks.label: Move-outs and deposit statements
playbooks.summary: Follows each move-out from the inspection and the work between tenants to the itemized deposit statement, by the due date in the company's records.

questions.ask: What has to agree before a trust account counts as reconciled?
questions.reply: Three figures: the adjusted bank balance, the receipts and disbursements record, and the total of the owner ledgers paid from that account (for the security deposits account, the total of deposits held). A difference is researched and listed as an exception, never forced. The section from our trust accounting procedure is in the panel.
questions.before: Finding the company's own rule meant knowing which procedure to open, or asking the person who wrote it.
questions.now: The answer comes from the company's own procedure, with the section shown.

result.query: reconciliation finished three figures agree adjusted bank balance receipts disbursements owner ledgers difference

results.heading: Three figures that must agree
results.text:
## Three figures that must agree

A reconciliation is finished only when three figures agree: the adjusted bank balance (the statement balance with deposits in transit and outstanding checks), the balance of the receipts and disbursements record, and the total of the owner ledgers paid from that account. For the security deposits account, the third figure is the total of the deposits held for residents. A difference is researched and listed as an exception. It is never forced to agree.

results.heading: Records
results.text:
## Records

Owner ledgers, tenant ledgers, the receipts and disbursements record, bank statements and reconciliations are kept for as long as our state's rules require. The retention period is state-specific, and the owner / broker sets it in our records policy.

results.heading: Monthly reconciliation
results.text:
## Monthly reconciliation

Our procedure says every trust account and the security deposits account is reconciled each month, once the bank statement for the month arrives and before owner distributions from that account go out. Accounting prepares each reconciliation and the owner / broker reviews and signs it off.

result.query: move-out inspection keys move-in condition record photos room

results.heading: The move-out inspection
results.text:
## The move-out inspection

After the resident returns the keys, the property manager or one of our technicians inspects the home against the move-in condition record, room by room, with photos. The inspection is saved in the inspection records the same day.

results.heading: The itemized deposit statement
results.text:
## The itemized deposit statement

The property manager decides any deduction from the inspection record, with a copy of each bill, invoice or receipt for the work. Accounting sends the itemized statement and any refund by the due date in our records. That date is set from our state's rule when the move-out is entered, and the assistant shows it rather than working it out.

results.heading: Before the move-out
results.text:
## Before the move-out

When a resident gives notice, we offer an inspection before they move out, so they can see what may be charged and fix it themselves first. We give the resident written notice before we enter.
